name: lk-ramis-tax-skills
description: Unofficial, community helpers for filing a Sri Lankan individual income tax return in the IRD's RAMIS system: a getting-started guide, AIT/WHT interest certificates to Schedule 7A, CSE shares/dividends/disposals, bank balances/liabilities/property, and a read-only final review with a supporting-documents checklist. Runs locally; human approval at every step; never signs in, saves or submits.
